entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How may I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. I bought it a couple of weeks ago and it's just not working out for me.
Certainly. Can you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit purchase?
It's [customer's email address]. I'm trying to return a VeloBand Pulse I bought. It's just… not what I expected.
Okay, one moment while I pull up your order. Thank you for your patience. I see the VeloBand Pulse here. Can you tell me why you are looking to return it?
Honestly? It doesn't track my sleep properly, and the heart rate monitor is all over the place. It's basically a useless smart watch. I want my money back.

I understand your frustration. Our return policy allows for returns within 90 days of purchase. I apologize the VeloBand Pulse isn't meeting your expectations. We want you to be completely satisfied with your VeloFit product.
90 days? Really? I thought I only had a short window. I'm already passed like 10 days since I got it.
Yes, you are correct. Our standard return policy is 90 days after purchase. So, no worries, you're well within the time frame. Would you like me to initiate the return process for you?
Yes, please! That would be great. I was worried I was stuck with it. I really appreciate it.

No problem at all. I've started the return process. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label via email within 24 hours. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse securely in its original packaging, attach the label, and drop it off at your nearest shipping location. Once we receive the returned item, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. It might take 7 to 10 business days for the refund to reflect on your account.
Wow, that's fantastic! Thank you so much. You've been a huge help. I was expecting a fight, to be honest.
You're very welcome. We value your business and want to ensure you have a positive experience with VeloFit. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you again!
You're welcome! Have a great day!
